spans.s:
--gods like आदित्यस्, Visvedevas, साध्यस्, पितृस्, sages like Angiras and so on at the beginning of दाहकल;
1: Br.

. २९; वा. 7. १५.
residents of तार and गृहस्;
2: वा. १०१. ३१.
at the commence- ment of Pralaya spring forth these gods, with planets and stars, with no social restrictions of caste or orders; went to Maharloka, Janaloka and lastly to Brahmaloka never to come back; appointed by the creator in different stations.
3: Br.
